newsitem.title: USA: Boston Ed now sees Pilgrim restart Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Boston Ed now sees Pilgrim restart Sunday.

text.p: Boston Edison Co said Friday restart of its 670 megawatt (MW) Pilgrim 1 nuclear power plant in Plymouth, Mass., was rescheduled to Sunday.
"Restart of Pilgrim is expected for Sunday and should be back on line late Sunday or early Monday," said company spokesman Dave Tarantino.
The company earlier said the station could resume operation Saturday.
Pilgrim was taken off line Tuesday, Sept 17 after plant crew discovered a saltwater leak at a set of heat exchangers in its reactor building.
The Pilgrim plant accounts for a third of Boston Edison's generating capacity.
